description: Call this when a user asks what ARC recorded for a store, or you need the citable store page. Returns the store page's verdict, checked_at (the day of the check), stale, category, tried (ARC's standard shoppers' newest dated run, or "Not measured"), the recorded fix, record_url (claimed, served, date and method as JSON) and links to the page, its JSON and Markdown. Example: store_record({"store":"allbirds.com"}) → {"verdict":"…","page_url":"https://www.arcreport.ai/stores/allbirds.com",…}. Reads the published snapshot behind /stores/<host>. Saved checks only: no store fetch, no scan, no login. Advisory; ARC stops before payment. Every answer carries checked_at (the saved check it rests on; for a list, the oldest) and stale (true when that check is 24 hours old or older, or has no time). Errors: {error:{code, message, next_step}}.

store.description: Store domain or URL, such as allbirds.com.
